# Python Data Access

## ORM (SQLAlchemy)

- Prefer **async** sessions if the app is async end-to-end; otherwise stay consistent with the codebase.
- Use **`select()`** / 2.0-style queries when that is the project standard.
- Avoid **N+1** queries; use `selectinload` / `joinedload` or projections intentionally.
- Prefer **projections** (DTOs / dicts) for list endpoints instead of loading full entity graphs.

## Migrations (Alembic)

- Generate migrations via CLI; **review** autogenerated scripts before merge.
- Avoid editing applied migrations; add a new revision to fix mistakes.

## Raw SQL

- Use **bound parameters** only; never format user input into SQL strings.

## Transactions

- Keep transactions **short**; commit at the end of a use-case, not per row in a loop when one transaction suffices.

## Security

- **Row-level** or **tenant** filters belong in the data layer or service layer consistently — document the rule in the spec when introducing multi-tenancy.
